fullPassage:
It would seem obvious that the more competent someone is, the more we will like that person. By "competence," I mean a cluster of qualities: smartness, the ability to get things done, wise decisions, etc.

(A) If this were true, we might like people more if they reveal some evidence of fallibility. For example, if your friend is a brilliant mathematician, superb athlete, and gourmet cook, you might like him or her better if, every once in a while, they screwed up.
(B) One possibility is that, although we like to be around competent people, those who are too competent make us uncomfortable. They may seem unapproachable, distant, superhuman — and make us look bad (and feel worse) by comparison.
(C) We have a better chance of doing well in our own life tasks when around someone who knows what they're doing and has a lot to teach us. But it doesn't always work this way.

(B) One possibility is that, although we like to be around competent people, those who are too competent make us (B)[uncomfortable / relaxed]. They may seem unapproachable, distant, superhuman — and make us look bad (and feel worse) by comparison. (C) We have a better chance of doing well in our own life tasks when around someone who knows what they're doing and has a lot to teach us. But it doesn't always work this way.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) competent=유능한, (B) uncomfortable=불편한, (C) fallibility=오류 가능성
det.analysis:
❌ ① indifferent — uncomfortable — fallibility: (A) indifferent(무관심한)는 competent(유능한)과 의미가 전혀 다름
❌ ② competent — relaxed — fallibility: (B) relaxed(편안한)는 uncomfortable(불편한)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ competent — uncomfortable — perfection: (C) perfection(완벽함)은 fallibility(오류 가능성)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ④ competent — uncomfortable — fallibility: 원문 일치. 너무 유능한(competent) 사람은 우리를 불편하게(uncomfortable) 만들고, 오류 가능성(fallibility)의 증거를 보여주면 더 좋아한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: too competent make us uncomfortable(너무 유능하면 불편) / evidence of fallibility(오류 가능성의 증거)
